findings.title: Guidance met by active argumentative obstruction
findings.claim: The focus's prevention of belief and forgiveness can also be read as an active procedure: varied examples are turned into contentious dispute, falsehood seeks to make truth lose its footing, and warnings are recoded as mockery.
findings.mechanism: The focus names arrived guidance and forgiveness as the blocked responses; 18:54 supplies varied examples and dispute, while 18:56 supplies falsehood, truth, slipping, signs, warnings, and mockery as the operations that perform the prevention.
findings.reader_payoff: The barrier becomes something people do after guidance has arrived, giving the focus's exclusive explanation a concrete rhetorical mechanism.
findings.containment: The plain restriction in 18:55 remains intact. This does not claim that every refusal or dispute has this mechanism; a reading of correlated refusal behaviors without one causal procedure remains possible.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel evidence has exact 18:54-56 carriers; the represented HFT trace is legacy_unbound and is preserved as qualified support rather than used as an acceptance vote.

findings.title: Precedent as a visible material cycle
findings.claim: The arriving precedent of earlier peoples can also be perceived as a recurring process already visible in the world: life is enlivened, breaks into dry fragments, and is dispersed.
findings.mechanism: The 18:45 sequence joins enlivened growth at 18:45:4 to brittle broken vegetation at 18:45:15 and wind-scattering at 18:45:16; those carriers contact the focus arrival of the established precedent.
findings.reader_payoff: The precedent becomes perceptible as a pattern that can recur in material change, not only as a report about people who came before.
findings.containment: The focus still names the established pattern of earlier peoples. This attributed contextual analogy does not equate their fate with vegetation or replace the historical reading.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact coordinates, roots, and focus return, but its reader identity is legacy_unbound; the inference and the live alternative of ordinary-world transience remain visible.

findings.containment: The focus still names punishment coming face-to-face. The reciprocal mechanism is attributed contextual inference; the scenes may also be read as adjacent judgment descriptions without one spatial mechanism.

epistemic.reason: Every HFT coordinate and root agrees with 18:47-49, while the reader identity is legacy_unbound and the reciprocal mechanism is explicitly marked as inference.

findings.containment: The focus still presents earlier precedent or punishment as the exclusive preventer. The opportunity-purpose of delay is attributed inference; delay may also be described as decree without that purpose.

findings.title: The focus Lord in a world-wide frame
findings.claim: The added Rabb al-alamin frame makes the focus's Rabbahum perceptible as a governing relation whose scope reaches beyond the immediate people: their request for forgiveness sits within a relation to the whole created field.

findings.reader_payoff: The Lord to whom forgiveness is sought is newly seen as a relation whose authority and care are not confined to the addressed group.
findings.containment: The overlay adds scope to the focus relation; 18:55 does not itself say Rabb al-alamin, and this does not import a complete Fatiha theology.

epistemic.reason: Exact external root occurrences and the focus branch record supply the contact, but the lean external projection provides no independent support record or target morphology beyond its supplied surface and roots.
